verdict.rationale: Warp documents right-clicking any error in command output to 'Ask Warp AI' for an explanation, including demystifying error messages and identifying missing dependencies. Its agent is documented to debug issues and fix errors. A community user corroborates receiving an unprompted LLM suggestion for fixing a syntax error after a test run. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on fix suggestions triggered by a failed command (the evidence is marketing-level), and detail on how suggested fixes are applied.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI explanations and suggested fixes when a command fails

citations.quote: Right‑click and 'Ask Warp AI' to explain any error in your command output. Warp AI can demystify opaque error messages and identify missing dependencies.
User got an unexpected LLM suggestion for fixing a syntax error after running a test.
